view-01.png.evidence: Service compound and runway organize the coast; soft player overlaps a blue-gray roof.

view-02.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, smoke and orange tracer integrate; small troops blend into rubble.

view-03.png.evidence: Luminous layered explosion, sparks and atmospheric cliffs give depth; nearby units partly disappear.

view-04.png.evidence: Player separates from grass; varied trees and partial compound enrich coast, with soft materials.

view-05.png.evidence: Quiet broad deck contrasts with water; bridge shadow, deck lines and soft wake add simple volume.

view-06.png.evidence: Raised hangars and broad apron establish base structure; player merges with roof. Dark rippled sea has depth but a clothlike repeating texture.

view-07.png.evidence: Crisp raised carrier, orange sparks and pale aircraft stand against dark rippled sea; overlapping aircraft obscure player at bow.

view-08.png.evidence: Sharp service compound, sheds, tracks and runway provide coherent geography; grass material remains simplified.

view-09.png.evidence: Broad pale deck shows through swarm, but overlapping wings and soft pale dots obscure central player.

view-10.png.evidence: Broad deck and bridge remain clear; simple surface shading and long soft wake.

view-11.png.evidence: Orange fire and pale wings are distinct from dark ocean; many separated gray smoke clusters and overlapping aircraft keep central action crowded.

view-12.png.evidence: Outlined player readable on grass; coastline cleaner than black-strip version, but coast remains a uniform abrupt boundary and terrain soft.

view-13.png.evidence: Soft carrier and aircraft contrast with dark water, with readable orange sparks; overlapping player and enemies at bow still ambiguous.

view-14.png.evidence: Sharp deck and broad wake stay coherent beneath dense aircraft; similar pale wings still mask player.

view-15.png.evidence: Raised building sides, tree shadows and clear player provide depth; clean shore transition improved, yet no irregular surf and ocean looks crumpled.

view-16.png.evidence: Quiet soft carrier has clear raised bridge and hull; dark textured water adds relief but wake repeats rounded bands.

view-17.png.evidence: Apron connects buildings and road; player merges into soft roof edges, while dark ripples contrast abruptly against pale smooth shore.

view-18.png.evidence: Broad tan ship contrasts with teal water and trailing wake; pale aircraft overlap deck.

view-19.png.evidence: Fog, varied vegetation, muddy ruts and weathered shed build rich depth; tanks blend with terrain.

view-20.png.evidence: Detailed rooms, wall height, warm/cool light, wood and tile create convincing depth.

view-21.png.evidence: Sharp tan deck and wake clarify ship; pale aircraft merge at deck overlap.

view-22.png.evidence: Market produce, stone, wood and fabric distinct under consistent shadows; thin paths remain visible.

view-23.png.evidence: Soft crowded wings and granular smoke clutter the deck; bright sparks read clearly, but the player's identity remains hard to track.

view-24.png.evidence: Edged player, varied tree tones and partial compound support hierarchy; fields remain simple patches.

view-25.png.evidence: Crisp raised bridge, striped tan deck and dark hull give strong ship volume; rippled dark sea gains relief but repeated scalloped wake remains schematic.

visible_regressions: Dark ocean relief sometimes resembles crumpled cloth rather than directional waves; its repeated dense texture competes more than quiet teal water.
Player still merges into hangar roofs in views06/17 and into aircraft at carrier bow.
Separated granular smoke clusters remain in crowded views11/23.
improvements: Black coastal seam is replaced by a cleaner muted shoreline.
Dark ocean adds visible relief and stronger contrast for pale aircraft.
Broad apron and raised buildings give base structure.
top3_gaps: Improve player separation from roofs and overlapping wings without relying only on a tiny ring.
Give smoke overlapping irregular wisps and expansion instead of discrete granular stamps.
Integrate shoreline surf and water surface response; avoid crumpled texture and uniformly smooth coast.
_summary.blinding_limitations: All25 images inspected. Consulted only own prior judge-a-8 record for exact unchanged score anchors; no keys, source or other judges. Recognizable game/reference families limit identity blinding; no mapping inferred.
